what: OPERATOR STYLE DIRECTIVE OF RECORD (trace 1a168b88e0391dfd): 'Why are you writing the lessons like The book said... — I dont want that. The lesson is going to 100% book replacement. Students can achieve top grades reading and studying from lesson.' The lesson is a STANDALONE interactive textbook, not a guided tour of the print book. Quantified violation surface: 448 book-voice hits across 112 sections in the 7 shipped packs (c01 18, c02 19, c03 52, c04 68, c05 174, c06 67, c07 50; all 15 c07 sections carry it) — attribution voice ('the book says/opens/hints', 'the book's KEY POINT/Figure 7.x'), QA provenance leaking into student prose (chunk ids, 'disclosed in the receipt'), and student-facing deflections ('open the student book PDF', book question-bank page narration).
why: A student who reads only the Lesson must receive the complete, self-sufficient instruction — top grades achievable without the print book. Authority-voice and PDF-deferral break that contract and teach students to treat the Lesson as a companion instead of the primary surface. Provenance has a dedicated layer (front-matter chunkRefs + qa/receipt.yaml); it must never ride student-facing prose.
fix: LESSON-PROSE@2.0.0 STANDALONE-VOICE LAW (prompt registry, this PR): (1) teach in the lesson's own authoritative second-person voice — state the chemistry, never attribute it; (2) zero book-attribution constructions in student prose ('the book', 'book's', figure/table numbers of the print book); (3) zero QA leakage (no chunk ids, no receipt/parse/print-heading talk in prose); (4) zero PDF-deflection (no 'open the student book', no book question-bank page narration — practice joins the platform question bank by specRefs, derived-links law); (5) book-derived facts stay fully carried (the substance is unchanged — only the voice changes); (6) provenance law untouched at the QA layer (front-matter chunkRefs, receipt ocr_notes, boxes mapping). c07 retrofit r1 ships in this PR; c01-c06 retrofit (398 hits) queued as the dedicated lane.
root_cause: The authoring prompt (lesson-prose@1.0.0) never pinned the narrative stance; agents defaulted to a guided-tour voice citing the source of record. Root-cause-twice law: this is the first systemic voice defect — the law now exists before the second pack generation.
